subject: Post-demo: trial starter commitments, acceptance criteria, and SDK routing map

Subject: Post-demo: trial starter commitments, acceptance criteria, and SDK routing map

Hi Alec — thanks again for taking the time this afternoon. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of what we agreed on
- Trial type: 2-week technical trial (non-production) to validate retrieval + generation workflows for product search restoration and intent extraction.
- Primary goals (success criteria):
  - Latency: p50 < 200ms on your dev workload, p95 < 800ms (for 512 tokens)
  - Throughput: sustain 400-600 requests/min with small bursts to 1k/min
  - Quality: intent classification accuracy >= 90% on the annotated sample set; embedding nearest-neighbor recall >= 0.85 vs. current baseline
  - Operational: reproducible rollout steps and observability (token-level cost visibility + per-route latency)

Proposed technical milestones (week 0–2)
1) Tech kickoff and credentials (Day 0) — confirm date below
2) Data drop & integration (Day 1–3) — sample logs + retrieval indices
3) Integration check (Day 4–7) — verify SDK calls, streaming, and tool-calling paths
4) Acceptance tests (Day 10–12) — run evaluation prompt set and report metrics
5) Wrap & next steps (Day 13–14) — decide on Dedicated vs Hosted path

Ownership
- Commercial/coordination: me (Marissa Cole)
- Trial operations & schedule: Ben Carter
- Technical lead / SDK + streaming handoff: Neha Kapoor

Immediate asks for your team
- Confirm kickoff window (we proposed Apr 30–May 2)
- Provide Eng contact(s) for the onboarding call (we added Priyanka if available)
- Share a short sample of your retrieval index (anonymized) and expected QPS profile

I've attached a short POC checklist (fathom_poc_checklist.xlsx) that maps the milestones above to deliverables and acceptance tests.

Next steps: if Apr 30 works, Ben and Neha will schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff and drop an invite.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Hi Alec + Priyanka — Neha here (tech lead). A short technical note so your Eng team has clear expectations before the kickoff. I've included code paths, recommended config, and minimal acceptance checks.

SDK / language support- Official SDKs: Python (recommended for evaluation), Node (official), Java (limited). We provide explicit streaming helpers in Python/Node.

Auth & routing
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
- Endpoints (trial project):
  - POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
    - body: {"model":"redwood-rl-1","input":...} (sync)
  - POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
    - chunked HTTP streaming (recommended for interactive playback)
  - WS wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/stream?project=RDW-4132 (for persistent streams from your side)

Tool-calling / structured outputs- We support JSON-schema function outputs and native function-calling. If you use a toolchain, consider locking the schema for the acceptance prompts to avoid regressions.

Batching & caching recommendations- Suggested batch size: 8–16 for generation; 32–128 for embeddings depending on token length.
- Enable prefix KV cache for repeated conversational contexts (saves 20–40% token compute).

Quantization / performance knobs- For dev trials we recommend int8 quantized variants for faster kernels with ~1.1–1.3x cost improvement. If you need strict latency SLOs, use the fp16 path on our dedicated burst slot.

Acceptance test checklist (technical)
1) SDK sanity: run sample generate + embedding calls and validate auth/403/200 flows
2) Streaming: establish a 30s stream and ensure chunk delivery within expected cadence
3) Throughput run: synthetic load to match 400–600 rps/min sustained for 10 minutes
4) Quality eval: run provided prompt set vs. baseline and produce the 3 metrics in the shared doc

Attachments & links- Included patch with API examples (api_examples.patch) and a short demo script.
- Dev docs: https://redwood.app/drive/fathom-poc-docs (auth view)
- HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/engagements/RDW-4132

Immediate asks for Priyanka's team
- Which SDK language should we prioritize (Python/Node)?
- Any firewall / egress IPs we need to white-list? We will provide a short list if required.

I'll be on the kickoff; happy to run the first integration checks with you.

—Neha Kapoor
